entries.zh: 皇家宗室，帝王宗族之亲属；王之亲族
entries.en: the king's kinsmen; members of the imperial clan

entries.zh: 亲戚，亲属情分；闽南用法中亦指亲事、聘礼之事
entries.en: relatives, kin, kinship ties; (Hokkien usage) marriage or betrothal matters

entries.zh: 族属亲戚；有宗族或姻亲关系之人
entries.en: connected kinsfolk; relatives by clan or by affinity

entries.zh: 手足，同胞兄弟；喻至亲
entries.en: brothers, siblings; lit. 'hand and foot', i.e. closest kin
entries.notes: 音写栏首音节污损难辨（T99），释义依汉字“手足”与词头义。

entries.zh: 宗族，同宗一族之人
entries.en: clan, lineage group; agnatic kindred

entries.zh: 宗亲，同宗之亲属
entries.en: clan relatives; kinsmen of the same lineage

entries.zh: 寒族，门第寒微之宗族；自称本族之谦辞
entries.en: humble clan; one's own kindred (self-deprecating)

entries.zh: 通族，阖族上下；整个宗族
entries.en: the whole clan; the entire lineage

entries.zh: 家亲，家中亲属；自家亲戚
entries.en: family relatives; household kin

entries.zh: 同辈，辈分相同之亲属；年辈相当者
entries.en: relatives of the same generation; equals, peers

entries.zh: 内亲，内层之亲；母系或妻方亲属
entries.en: inner relatives; kin on the maternal or wife's side
entries.notes: 音写栏尾部“us. Huepᵉ”（含上标缩写符）无法辨释展开，释义依汉字与首两音节。

entries.zh: 父族，父方宗亲；父系亲属
entries.en: the father's clan; relatives on the paternal side

entries.zh: 母族，母方宗亲；母系亲属
entries.en: the mother's clan; relatives on the maternal side

entries.zh: 外亲，外家之亲；母方亲属
entries.en: outer relatives; kin on the mother's side

entries.zh: 更亲，谓更隔一层之亲属；西语栏标注为母方亲戚
entries.en: further, next-degree kin; the Spanish column notes them as mother's-side relatives
entries.notes: “更親”非习见亲属复合词，音写两音节与汉字相合而字义存疑，兼依西语栏“p. de madr.”（母方亲戚）。

entries.zh: 骨肉，至亲血亲；喻最亲近之亲属
entries.en: flesh and blood; nearest kin, closest relative
entries.notes: 音写栏首音节污损难辨（T99），释义依汉字“骨肉”与西语词头“最亲近之亲属”。

entries.zh: 至亲，最亲近之亲属
entries.en: closest kin; nearest relative

entries.zh: 亲疏，亲属之近与疏；近亲与远亲之别
entries.en: kin near and distant; degrees of kinship
entries.notes: 音写栏并列两读，西语栏连写且含缩写“Herᵐᵒ.”（疑为 hermano），释义取汉字“親踈”本义。

entries.zh: 疏房，宗族中关系较疏之支房；远房
entries.en: distant branch of the clan; remote kinsmen

entries.zh: 疏族，关系疏远之族人；远族
entries.en: distant clansmen; remote kinsmen
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（“parientes [残]e moſos”），释义依汉字“踈族”及音写栏。

entries.zh: 亲眷，亲戚眷属；亲属之总称
entries.en: relatives, kinsfolk; family connections

entries.zh: 因姻亲附而成之亲；姻亲，缔结婚姻而结成的亲属
entries.en: relatives by marriage; affines, in-laws

entries.zh: 疏堂，同宗远房堂亲；宗支疏远之堂房
entries.en: distant hall-kin; remote relatives of the paternal hall
entries.notes: 西语栏沿写“por caſamientſ”（因婚姻之亲）与汉字“踈堂”义不相合，释义依汉字与音写栏。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: close relatives; near kinsmen
entries.notes: 汉字与音写栏俱空（[空]），中文释义无从立据；仅西语词头 parientes cercanos 可读。
